title: Closure of SingPost Offices and Impact on Availability Standards for Services such as Passport Collection
what_it_is: Closure of SingPost Offices and Impact on Availability Standards for Services such as Passport Collection

sections.label: Post office service arrangements
sections.summary: Public agency services at post offices are bound by contracts, not postal availability standards, and agencies are exploring alternatives as SingPost optimises its network.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The arrangements made by public agencies to provide Government services at post offices are bound by contractual agreements rather than availability standards under our postal regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Agencies that provide services through post offices are actively exploring alternative arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The closure of the Clementi Central Post Office is part of SingPost's plan to optimise its post office network.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Customers will continue to have access to a POPStation parcel locker at Clementi Mall and a Self-Service Automated Machine (SAM) kiosk located 300 metres away.

sections.label: ServiceSG Centres for digital transactions
sections.summary: Residents needing help with Government digital transactions can use ServiceSG Centres, with seven now and two more by year-end.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, residents who need assistance with Government digital transactions can walk in to ServiceSG Centres to access about 600 frequently used Government services and schemes across more than 25 public agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: There are now seven ServiceSG Centres located around Singapore and another two to be operationalised by the end of this year.

sections.label: Alternative SingPost offices and agents
sections.summary: Residents were told alternatives are in West Coast, Teban Gardens or Ghim Moh, and SingPost is looking at third party postal agents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Some of my residents were told that the nearest available alternative SingPost offices would be in West Coast, Teban Gardens or Ghim Moh, despite Clementi Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) being a transport node and a future MRT interchange.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I mentioned earlier the POPStation located at Clementi Mall, which is the same location as the original Clementi Central Post Office, and at the SAM kiosk located 300 metres away at Block 451 Clementi Avenue 3.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: SingPost is also looking at third party postal agents, for example, supermarkets and so on, in which these can provide services to the residents in the vicinity.
